name: campfire
description: Twenty seconds at 60 fps: once round the fire a metre and a half over the sand six metres out, looking at the flame, then in to two and a half metres on the downwind side, under the smoke. README.md says what each marker shows.

markers.name: east
markers.note: From six metres east: the flame, the ring of stones and the logs, the sand lit orange round them and falling to the moonlight in a few metres.

markers.name: west
markers.note: From the west, the other side: the shadows of the stones and the logs thrown away from the fire under --shadows rt, and the smoke leaning downwind.

markers.name: close
markers.note: Two and a half metres from the flame: the near flame marched per pixel, its tongues and its colour from the base to the tips.
